dedupe_keys.name: temoaproject building conflict uncertainty into electricity planning a south sudan case study

description: Neha Patankar and co-authors archive the Temoa code and data used for a study of conflict uncertainty in South Sudan electricity planning. The native description identifies the stochastic model and states that the analysis used Pyomo 4.3. A ZIP contains the study package and a separate XLSX descriptor identifies a calculation and results summary. Together these form one study-specific electricity-planning bundle, with the general Temoa model linked separately. Zenodo provides free open access and states GPL 2.0 for the deposit. Coverage is South Sudan; the inspected metadata does not define conflict scenarios, simulation years, regional nodes or numerical variables. Those unknowns limit reuse without inspecting the package later. The repository’s instructions refer to a README, but it was not fetched. No code, archive or workbook body was read, and neither results nor reproducibility were checked.
